ios.desc:
VybeCam is the first app that lets you discover music by taking pictures.

Take a photo, and within seconds, VybeCam finds the song that feels exactly right for that moment.

It’s like Shazam in reverse: Instead of finding the song you’re hearing, VybeCam finds the song you want to be hearing.

How it works
 1. Open VybeCam and capture your current VYBE.
 2. Our algorithm analyzes your photo’s emotion, lighting, and energy.
 3. Get your perfect track - a real song that matches how you feel.
 4. Save or share your vibe with friends on Instagram, TikTok, or Snapchat.

Free to use. Built to feel. Everyone starts with 6 free VYBEs. When you run out, you can:
 • Share your VYBE to get 3 more per day.
 • Wait 24 hours for your daily recharge.
 • Upgrade to Premium and get unlimited VYBEs.

Upgrade to VybeCam Premium for:
 • Unlimited VYBEs (camera + gallery access).
 • Sharper AI matching.
 • No ads, ever.
